chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Al-Ṣaffār, one of the transmitters in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ: Al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the named transmitter.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating direct transmission by the compiler through the cited chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for the narrations of al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It serves as a technical statement of hadith transmission, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd.
